title: Verify data lineage traceability for a new record
gherkin:
Feature: Data Lineage Traceability
  Scenario: Reporting lineage for a newly created record
    Given a new rent record is created
    When the record is saved
    Then the system should log the creation event with a timestamp and user identifier
    And the lineage should reflect the creation of the record
rationale: To ensure that the system accurately tracks the creation of new records and logs the necessary details for traceability.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin tests for the requirement of reporting data lineage traceability, ensuring that the system can effectively track and report the lineage of data throughout its lifecycle.
resolutionNotes: Filtered abstract or low-relevance operative statements: The system shall maintain the full lifecycle history of each rent record. | The system shall log all rent lifecycle events, including creation, approval, rejection, activation, completion, cancellation, and modification. | The system shall store the timestamp and user identifier for each lifecycle event.
